## Summary

Describe the problem and the solution in a few sentences.

## Validation

- [ ] `npm test`
- [ ] `npm run build`
- [ ] Tested interactively in a supported browser when the UI or gameplay changed

## Release hygiene

- [ ] The change keeps all public-facing teams, drivers, sponsors, and branding fictional.
- [ ] No credentials, local deployment metadata, generated audio, or build output are included.
- [ ] New binary assets have provenance recorded in `ASSET_PROVENANCE.md`.
- [ ] New dependencies have their version and license recorded in `THIRD_PARTY_NOTICES.md` and `LICENSES/`.
- [ ] Documentation covers user-visible behavior changes.

## Screenshots or recordings

Include before-and-after evidence for visual changes, or write “Not applicable.”
